metricSemantics.instances: Cube renderers submit one instance per voxel; shared-static-meshes submits one per prop/transition copy. Compare equivalentCells for LOD budgets, not instances.
metricSemantics.preparationMs: Cube renderer packing work; static renderer whole update planning/batch work. These are different operations.
metricSemantics.gpuAndCpu: Published moving diagnostic samples retain their native cadence; repeated RAF reads are not independent GPU/CPU timings. RAF intervals measure actual observed frame scheduling. Geometry/instance bytes are reported storage counters, not total RAM or VRAM.

scope: Same forest fixture, continuous captured drag with zoom changes, repeated RAF trials per viewport. Chrome CPU throttling is host emulation, not physical-phone performance. Screenshots use separate route. Frame counters preserve their publication cadence; per-tree/cancellation/age/transition metrics are null on builds without those diagnostics. Matched fractions include actual observed time; unfinished mismatch segments are censored observations, not successful refinements. UI latency includes main-thread scheduling. No universal FPS/latency guarantee.
